title: Partial object checks
summary: objectContaining checks selected fields when other fields are not part of the current test.
introduction: objectContaining checks selected fields when other fields are not part of the current test. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: objectContaining checks selected fields when other fields are not part of the current test.

blocks.code:
import { test, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from "vitest";
test("has a title", () => { expect({ title: "Moon", pages: 24 }).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ title: "Moon" })); });
blocks.title: Partial object checks

blocks.text: The title is checked. The pages field is allowed but not checked by this expectation.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add an author to the actual object.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A partial match does not prove unmentioned fields are correct.
For more detail later, use this [Vitest further reading](https://vitest.dev/guide/).
